name: SCION
aliases: Scene Composition with Instanced Neural Primitives
definition: A factorized Gaussian scene representation that stores a reusable vocabulary of local primitives and a set of world-space instances. Each instance selects one primitive and places a transformed copy into the scene, enabling compact representation for repetitive structures.
summary: SCION is a hierarchical scene representation that replaces standard 3D Gaussian Splatting with reusable primitives and instances, enabling compact storage and instance-level editing without retraining.
